plugins.name: katip-kalkan
plugins.description: Katip for Turkish lawyers, run on your computer. It masks KVKK personal data in client documents (UYAP .udf, Word, PDF, scans) before Claude reads them, and works behind that mask: it checks statute citations offline against mevzuat, names document types, searches Yargıtay precedents (off by default), and screens a person or company against MASAK, ilan.gov.tr and the Ticaret Sicili Gazetesi for a DD raporu (beta). Avukatlar için KVKK maskeleme, mevzuat atıf kontrolü, emsal arama ve DD taraması.

description: Katip: local-first legal AI tools for Turkish law firms. Client data is masked on your computer before Claude reads a document; statute checks, precedent search and DD screening work behind that mask.
